talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $123.9M sold across 11 Form D filings this week, down 71% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Deon Health Inc. (Port Huron, Other Health Care) targeting $10M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
High Street Holdco, LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 3 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

6 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $113.5M raised so far — led by Solyco Portfolio SPV 2 LLC (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
